std-302-1.0:38462C1A-999E-520E-BE56-FA3F.response: The committee defers this comment to the next revision cycle. Product hold scopes require comprehensive risk-assessment data that will be studied by a dedicated working group before any modifications are proposed.

std-302-1.0:5E9F2CDA-B022-53E7-AA02-F23E.comment: At Dubois Farmstead, drafting detailed environmental maps for every single aging cave creates significant administrative overhead for small producers. Weekly and monthly verification schedules already strain our limited staffing resources without adding extra documentation burdens.
std-302-1.0:5E9F2CDA-B022-53E7-AA02-F23E.response: The committee acknowledges the resource challenges faced by farmstead producers. However, a written sampling map is essential for targeted pathogen control and traceability, aligning with standard industry practices and the federal floor.

std-302-1.0:65D40948-FA0D-5DB6-9F63-6AB6.comment: In our facility at Elderfen Farm in Oaxaca, we find the term raw-milk soft cheese is clear, but adding a hyphenation check and ensuring consistent capitalization will help align this section with international labeling practices.
std-302-1.0:65D40948-FA0D-5DB6-9F63-6AB6.proposedChange: Ensure consistent hyphenation of raw-milk soft cheese throughout the second sentence of §3.
std-302-1.0:65D40948-FA0D-5DB6-9F63-6AB6.response: The committee accepts the editorial correction to ensure consistent hyphenation of raw-milk soft cheese in the text.

std-302-1.0:6B4BF43A-4C16-5DAD-9EA3-F3ED.comment: At Quernstone Creamery, our students in Emmental work with a vast array of aging cellars. Mandating a strict written map for every single room regardless of size creates an unnecessary administrative burden for artisan producers who operate small, single-shelf caves. The current scope is overly prescriptive.
std-302-1.0:6B4BF43A-4C16-5DAD-9EA3-F3ED.response: The committee notes the concern regarding small artisan caves, but maintaining a written map of sampling points is essential for environmental control and traceability across all aging rooms. The text stands as written.

std-302-1.0:73619338-F1FC-50C4-8C4A-3585.comment: At Elderfen Cheese & Provisions, we believe the sampling frequency text is mostly clear, but adding a specific minimum time interval between monthly swabs would prevent ambiguity for retail aging rooms that operate on irregular calendar schedules.
std-302-1.0:73619338-F1FC-50C4-8C4A-3585.proposedChange: Amend to specify that monthly environmental swabs shall be conducted at intervals of at least twenty-five days.
std-302-1.0:73619338-F1FC-50C4-8C4A-3585.response: The committee accepts the editorial clarification regarding the minimum interval between monthly swabs and has updated the text accordingly.

std-302-1.0:74C2B126-78E7-5C93-BEA8-E048.comment: Section 2 establishes a solid baseline for environmental mapping in aging rooms. As a cheese program director, I approve the provision and suggest adding a clarifying reference to facility diagrams.
std-302-1.0:74C2B126-78E7-5C93-BEA8-E048.proposedChange: Add a cross-reference to facility blueprints at the end of §2.
std-302-1.0:74C2B126-78E7-5C93-BEA8-E048.response: The committee accepts the suggestion in principle. While facility blueprints are useful, adding a mandatory cross-reference is unnecessary as facilities already maintain standard architectural schematics.

std-302-1.0:74C2B126-78E7-5C93-BEA8-E048.comment: Requiring weekly swabs exclusively for raw-milk soft cheese rooms in §3 creates an ambiguous distinction. Pasteurized soft cheeses can also host moisture-loving pathogens, so frequency should be based on moisture content rather than milk type alone.
std-302-1.0:74C2B126-78E7-5C93-BEA8-E048.proposedChange: Update §3 to require weekly environmental swabs for all high-moisture soft cheese aging rooms regardless of milk pasteurization status.
std-302-1.0:74C2B126-78E7-5C93-BEA8-E048.response: The committee accepts the principle that high-moisture soft cheeses present elevated risks. Section 3 will be updated AcceptedInPrinciple to include high-moisture soft cheese rooms alongside raw-milk soft cheese rooms for weekly testing.

std-302-1.0:75F3B7F3-5CE6-5E42-9EE3-76A4.comment: At our creamery in Trikala, the requirement for weekly swabs in rooms holding raw-milk soft cheese is clear. However, changing the prepositional phrasing slightly will improve the flow of the sentence for non-native English speakers.
std-302-1.0:75F3B7F3-5CE6-5E42-9EE3-76A4.proposedChange: Replace in rooms holding with for rooms containing.
std-302-1.0:75F3B7F3-5CE6-5E42-9EE3-76A4.response: The committee accepts the editorial refinement to improve the clarity and professional tone of the sentence.

std-302-1.0:7D1D1249-BCD3-5AC4-B842-99FE.comment: As a regional sales director supplying culture and monitoring materials, I find the wording in §1 robust and clear. I approve the section as written, with a minor tweak to alphabetize the listed sampling points.
std-302-1.0:7D1D1249-BCD3-5AC4-B842-99FE.proposedChange: Order the sampling points alphabetically as: air handlers, floor drains, shelves and walls.
std-302-1.0:7D1D1249-BCD3-5AC4-B842-99FE.response: The committee accepts the editorial suggestion to reorganize the list alphabetically for better readability. The revised text will reflect this order.

std-302-1.0:8010857E-9CEF-56E7-8879-A72A.comment: At Quincewick Creamery Cooperative, our aging caves span multiple subterranean levels and complex ventilation zones. Requiring a single comprehensive written map under §1 fails to accommodate dynamic mapping updates when air handlers are repositioned or repaired.
std-302-1.0:8010857E-9CEF-56E7-8879-A72A.proposedChange: Add a provision allowing digital, dynamically updated maps that reflect real-time air handler configurations.
std-302-1.0:8010857E-9CEF-56E7-8879-A72A.response: The committee defers this technical comment for the next revision of the document, as it requires broader consultation regarding digital mapping standards and document control software integration across member facilities.

std-302-1.0:82E5E82A-9152-53FD-A6FF-20F3.comment: The list of sampling points omits evaporator drip pans, which are a major vector in high humidity aging rooms. As a supplier of monitoring equipment, I see these areas harbouring moisture and biofilms constantly, so leaving them off the written map is a critical oversight.
std-302-1.0:82E5E82A-9152-53FD-A6FF-20F3.proposedChange: Amend §1 to read: Each aging room has a written map of sampling points: shelves, floor drains, walls, evaporator drip pans and air handlers.
std-302-1.0:82E5E82A-9152-53FD-A6FF-20F3.response: The committee agrees that evaporator drip pans represent a critical environmental niche in aging rooms. The suggestion is accepted, and the text will be updated to include evaporator drip pans in the required mapping list.

std-302-1.0:958B1085-3310-588F-AAC0-31AA.comment: As a production lead in Seattle, I appreciate the simplicity of §1. To make the requirement punchier and grammatically seamless for technicians reading the manual on the floor, we should adjust the punctuation of the listed sampling points.
std-302-1.0:958B1085-3310-588F-AAC0-31AA.proposedChange: Change the punctuation to: shelves, floor drains, walls, and air handlers.
std-302-1.0:958B1085-3310-588F-AAC0-31AA.response: The committee accepts the proposed punctuation change to improve readability and grammatical consistency.

std-302-1.0:958B1085-3310-588F-AAC0-31AA.comment: Reviewing §2 from my production perspective in Seattle, the phrasing is solid, but adding the word calendar before monthly will eliminate any ambiguity regarding 30-day testing windows.
std-302-1.0:958B1085-3310-588F-AAC0-31AA.proposedChange: Change monthly to calendar monthly in the first clause of §2.
std-302-1.0:958B1085-3310-588F-AAC0-31AA.response: The committee accepts the suggestion to insert the word calendar to clarify the monthly sampling interval.

std-302-1.0:AC73CCD5-783B-5A03-9A6B-3A97.comment: At Pippinvale Farm, we support the requirement for a written map. However, the phrasing could be slightly tightened to improve clarity regarding air handlers and structural surfaces so that inspectors do not misinterpret the exact boundaries of a sampling zone.
std-302-1.0:AC73CCD5-783B-5A03-9A6B-3A97.proposedChange: Change to read: Each aging room shall maintain a written map of specific sampling points including shelves, floor drains, walls, and air handlers.
std-302-1.0:AC73CCD5-783B-5A03-9A6B-3A97.response: The committee accepts the proposed wording change to clarify that sampling points must be specifically mapped for shelves, floor drains, walls, and air handlers.

std-302-1.0:B2A26737-D6CB-5149-8848-01C2.comment: At Pinebarrow Creamery in Chicago, weekly swabbing for raw-milk soft cheese rooms creates a severe bottleneck for our laboratory turnaround times. We suggest permitting composite swabbing for rooms holding identical make-days to reduce testing fatigue while maintaining safety.
std-302-1.0:B2A26737-D6CB-5149-8848-01C2.proposedChange: Modify §3 to permit composite environmental swabbing for multiple rooms holding the same lot of raw-milk soft cheese.
std-302-1.0:B2A26737-D6CB-5149-8848-01C2.response: The committee accepts the principle of operational flexibility, but composite environmental swabs compromise individual room traceability. The committee addresses this by adding an explanatory note allowing concurrent processing of separate swabs.

std-302-1.0:BA129EA6-B517-5C25-9F0D-D2D5.comment: I approve the monthly and weekly testing schedules for our aging rooms. However, the wording lacks clarity regarding when the weekly count restarts after a room is emptied for sanitation. For our courses taught at chapter meet-ups, we need the text to explicitly state that the weekly clock resets upon completion of the sanitation cycle to avoid trainee confusion.
std-302-1.0:BA129EA6-B517-5C25-9F0D-D2D5.proposedChange: Change to read: Environmental swabs at least monthly in every room, and weekly in rooms holding raw-milk soft cheese, with the weekly schedule restarting immediately following any complete room sanitation cycle.

std-302-1.0:EC981BB1-1AFE-5B09-93C4-BC11.response: The committee notes the concern regarding sampling intensity. Although §1 governs mapping rather than frequency, the principle of enhanced verification is addressed under §2 with the weekly requirement for raw-milk soft cheese rooms.

std-302-1.0:FBB1722E-F036-5279-BD6C-F190.response: The committee thanks the reviewer for the close read, but declines the edit. Current industry terminology commonly uses the open compound noun without a hyphen.

std-302-1.0:FBB1722E-F036-5279-BD6C-F190.response: The committee accepts the proposed change to provide greater scheduling precision. Section 3 will be revised to specify every thirty days for general environmental swabs.
